boundary_note: Ostrolenka 16 February; action on both banks and pre-action command strengths distinguished. Tactical and campaign replacement boundaries are unset; phases are research hypotheses. No feature admission or historical rating fit.

claims.value: Bodart: side A (French) 20,000 men; side B (Russian) 18,000 men.
claims.rationale: Read on the registered page image. His general rule is forces disposable for the engagement, rounded upward (shared research-conventions index); a stated siege endpoint or engaged subset takes precedence over treating it as an opening count. Population/timing alternatives are not reconciled. English rendering (ours): "French victory (20,000 men) under General of Division Savary over the Russians (18,000 men) under Lieutenant-General Count Essen I."

citations.quote: Sieg der Franzosen (20.000 M.) unter Div.-Gen. Savary über die Russen (18.000 M.) unter Gen.-Lt. Gf. Essen I.

claims.value: Bodart lists side A under Div.-Gen. Savary; side B under Gen.-Lt. Gf. Essen I.
claims.rationale: Printed attribution, not automatic allocation of tactical or campaign credit. Titles and spellings remain source-specific; additional passages distinguish superior from local authority. claims.value: The frozen frame records side A as Bodart's winner.
claims.rationale: Retains the frozen winner convention. A capitulation date and physical handover can differ; historical source disputes remain separate. English rendering (ours): "French victory (20,000 men) under General of Division Savary over the Russians (18,000 men) under Lieutenant-General Count Essen I."

citations.quote: Sieg der Franzosen (20.000 M.) unter Div.-Gen. Savary über die Russen (18.000 M.) unter Gen.-Lt. Gf. Essen I.

claims.value: Side A: Höpfner places not quite 20,000 men in Savary’s fifth corps and Becker’s dragoon division before the action; this is the wider command, not a synchronized engaged count.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "Opposite the Russians, Savary commanded in place of the sick Lannes the 5th corps and Becker’s dragoon division, therefore not quite 20,000 men"

citations.quote: Den Russen gegenüber befehligte an Stelle des erkrankten M. Lannes der General Savary das 5. Korps und die Dragoner-Division Becker, also noch nicht voll 20,000 Mann

claims.value: Side B: the French bulletin puts Essen at the head of 25,000 men advancing along both Narew banks on the day before the battle.
claims.rationale: Opposing pre-action estimate; not a Russian return or identical to Bodart’s population. English rendering (ours): "General Essen, at the head of 25,000 men, advanced on Ostrolenka on the 15th along both Narew banks."

citations.quote: Le général Essen, à la tête de 25,000 hommes, s’est porté sur Ostrolenka, le 15, par les deux rives de la Narew.

claims.value: Savary acted for the sick Lannes; Höpfner has Essen direct the operation and Wolchonski command the other bank’s column.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "Savary commanded the 5th corps in place of the sick Marshal Lannes" English rendering (ours): "The attack was to be made on both Narew banks: Prince Wolchonski from Goniondz via Kolno, and Essen himself directly from Wysoki Masowiecki."

citations.quote: an Stelle des erkrankten M. Lannes der General Savary das 5. Korps
Der Angriff sollte auf beiden Ufern des Narews geführt werden, nämlich der Fürst Wolchonski von Goniondz über Kolno, der General Essen selbst unmittelbar von Wysoki Masowiecki aus.

claims.value: The French bulletin gives Oudinot the left, Suchet the centre and Reille a Gazan brigade on the right when Savary formed for his attack.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "Oudinot, on two lines, commanded the left; Suchet the centre; Reille commanding a Gazan brigade formed the right."

citations.quote: le général Oudinot, sur deux lignes, commandait la gauche; le général Suchet, le centre; et le général Reille, commandant une brigade de la division Gazan, formait la droite.

claims.value: Höpfner says Essen was ordered to disturb the French rear and chose to take Ostrolenka.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "After Eylau, Essen received the order to disturb the French army’s rear. He decided to take Ostrolenka for this purpose"

citations.quote: Nach der Schlacht bei Pr. Eylau erhielt der General Essen endlich den Befehl, die französische Armee im Rücken zu beunruhigen. Der General beschloß, hierzu den Punkt von Ostrolenka fortzunehmen

claims.value: The officer carrying Essen’s proposed attack report to Bennigsen was captured by the French in Höpfner.
claims.rationale: Capture does not establish who read the report or exactly when. English rendering (ours): "However, the officer who was to inform Bennigsen of the planned attack fell into French hands."

citations.quote: jedoch fiel der Offizier, welcher dem General Bennigsen die Meldung von dem projektirten Angriff machen sollte, den Franzosen in die Hände.

claims.value: The French bulletin describes fighting inside the town and Russian retirement behind its covering sandhills.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "that he abandoned the town and took position behind the sandhills covering it."

citations.quote: qu’il abandonna la ville et prit position derrière les monticules de sable qui la couvrent.

claims.value: Side B attacked the town while Savary attacked Wolchonski on the other bank, then Savary attacked from the town.
claims.rationale: Main attacks on distinct banks, rather than coding only the town defence. English rendering (ours): "On 16 February at 9 o’clock Savary advanced through a Skwa ford against the Russian position’s flank" English rendering (ours): "At the same moment the enemy was attacking Ostrolenka from the left bank."

citations.quote: Am 16. Februar ging der General Savary um 9 Uhr durch eine Furth der Skwa gegen die Flanke der russischen Aufstellung vor
Mais au même moment l’ennemi attaquait Ostrolenka par la rive gauche.
